SIGNATURE.LAUNCH_CREATE_WARN: This signature creates a PUBLIC token sale with the exact terms below and makes this account its creator. The raise and any unsold tokens can only ever be sent to the creator address. Review every field - anything wrong here goes on-chain.
SIGNATURE.LAUNCH_CANCEL_WARN: This signature cancels the sale at the round contract shown above. Buyers are refunded; the deposited supply returns to the creator. Only the round creator’s signature is valid.
SIGNATURE.LAUNCH_RETARGET_WARN: This signature points the round’s raise-lock at the new Locker lock ids below. Only the round creator’s signature is valid.
SIGNATURE.LAUNCH_DEADLINE_STALE: This signature window looks already expired on this device’s clock - the chain will refuse it. Ask the online device for a fresh payload.
SIGNATURE.LAUNCH_CREATOR_NOTE: This account becomes the round’s creator - the raise and unsold tokens can only be sent to this address.
SIGNATURE.LAUNCH_UNVERIFIED: as reported by the online device, unverified
SIGNATURE.SWEEP_TOKEN_UNSIGNED: shown for context only - not signed, the contract derives it from the lock
SIGNATURE.SWEEP_WARN: This pays nothing out. It moves this token's rescuable surplus INTO the lock above, after which those same funds can only leave under the full signer quorum - the exact complement of a rescue. The amount credited may be lower than the signed ceiling.
SIGNATURE.SIGNER_NOTE: = the account you sign with below
SIGNATURE.SOFTCAP_MINBUY_MAXWALLET: Soft cap / min buy / max per account (USD 1e18)
SIGNATURE.DECODED_LOCKER_OP_SUFFIX: - the fields shown are what you are signing; this device recomputes the hash locally. It does NOT tell you WHICH locker or chain: check the verifying contract and the chain shown above.
SIGNATURE.HL_WITHDRAW_EXPLAIN: Withdraws USDC from your Hyperliquid perps account to the address below on Arbitrum. Hyperliquid charges a flat 1 USDC fee.
SIGNATURE.HL_WITHDRAW_FOREIGN_DEST: The destination is NOT the requesting account. A compromised computer may be redirecting your funds - refuse unless you chose this address yourself.
SIGNATURE.HL_AGENT_EXPLAIN: This key can place and cancel orders on your perps account. It can NEVER withdraw or transfer funds. It lives in the browser extension, encrypted.
SIGNATURE.HL_AGENT_NO_EXPIRY: This agent never expires. Only approve it if that is what you intend.
SIGNATURE.HL_FEE_EXPLAIN: Maximum fee the Locker wallet may add per perps order. It is always shown on the order summary before you trade.
SIGNATURE.HL_TESTNET_WARN: Testnet action - this is not the real Hyperliquid environment.
SIGNATURE.SINGLE_KEY_BODY: - this sets the approval threshold to 1: afterwards a single signature moves all funds (no multisig protection). Only sign if you intend a solo locker.
SIGNATURE.UNKNOWN_FACTORY_TITLE: This LaunchFactory is not in this device's known list.
SIGNATURE.UNKNOWN_FACTORY_BODY: Confirm the factory address above before signing.
SIGNATURE.ACK_RAW_CALLDATA: This request contains a contract call this device could NOT verify. I understand I am signing unverified raw calldata and accept the risk.
SIGNATURE.BATCH_REVIEW: operations - review EACH one below before signing.
SIGNATURE.WARN_UNSUPPORTED_TX_TYPE: This device cannot build or display this transaction envelope type. Signing is refused: the vault never re-envelopes a transaction into a type you did not review.
